site.name: A M Mine
site.location: Leadville North quadrangle, northwest of Leadville
overview: A M Mine is a named historic mine locality northwest of Leadville in Lake County, preserved on Leadville North quadrangle mapping.
moreHistory: The mapped point at approximately 39.253601, -106.289190 is used to identify the historic mine locality. It does not establish the position or present condition of any surviving shaft, portal, or underground working, and it does not imply public access.
